ITEM 1 | Breaded or battered bite-sized pieces with golden-orange glossy sauce coating, irregular chunks about 2-3 cm, sitting on upper-left portion of plate, covering roughly 20% of plate area, moderate height about 2 cm, slightly sticky sheen | 160
ITEM 2 | Shredded pale cabbage and thin orange carrot strands, lightly moist, scattered over and beside the coated pieces on the left side, covering about 8% of plate, flat and thin about 0.5 cm | 35
ITEM 3 | Dark purple shredded cabbage strands tucked under the coated pieces, crisp-looking, covering about 3% of plate, thin about 0.5 cm | 10
ITEM 4 | Bright green broccoli florets with dense crowns and slightly firm stems, matte surface, covering about 15% of plate in the upper-right area, rounded clusters about 2-4 cm tall | 70
ITEM 5 | Fresh dark green arugula-type leaves, flat, ruffled, slightly glossy and moist, covering about 25% of plate on the right and lower-center, leaves about 5-8 cm long, low mound about 2 cm high | 45
ITEM 6 | Brown granular cooked grain or lentil-like mixture with small pale bits, slightly moist and clumped, sitting at lower-left edge under the coated pieces, covering about 6% of plate, about 0.8 cm thick | 40
ITEM 7 | Glossy reddish-orange sauce pooled on and around the coated pieces and cabbage, thin film with sheen, covering about 4% of plate | 15
